quality_gates: greenfield commercial ideas complete or explicitly skip the idea pressure test before Gate 1
idea pressure test declares continue, pivot, research-needed, or pause with a core assumption and fast disconfirming test
live research completed or blocked explicitly
discovery brainstorming records mode, critical questions, options, and assumptions
all requirements have EARS acceptance criteria
all major stack choices cite official docs and current open-source evidence
all major subsystems include a reuse, integration, fork, pattern-extraction, or build-from-scratch decision
state truth model declares persisted, runtime-only, derived, reset, snapshot, diff, and migration behavior
workflow/navigation/action contract declares routes, screens, dialogs, commands, transitions, side effects, and invalid transitions
module/file responsibility contract declares ownership, allowed content, forbidden content, dependency direction, and public interfaces
generated artifact contract maps each generated output to a source declaration, generator command, and no-hand-edit rule
deterministic judge/evidence contract maps each requirement to code, state, API, file, screenshot, log, or manual evidence
data sufficiency check confirms fixtures, default data, reference cases, bad cases, regression cases, and edge cases support the planned workflows
stage gates require confirmation after brief plus research and after PRD plus requirements plus technical design
feature-mode packs include existing-system reality, compatibility contract, integration plan, and regression cases
reference, bad, and regression cases declare provenance as user-confirmed, real-source-derived, existing-test-derived, or synthetic
build-ready evals include at least one non-synthetic reference case
all tasks include validation commands or evidence requirements
traceability maps requirements to design, contracts, tasks, and evals
